label: replication rerun
study: Boing, A.C. et al. (2020). Quantifying and explaining variation in life expectancy at census tract, county, and state levels in the United States. PNAS 117:17688-17694 (headline null-model shares)
target: Shares of life-expectancy variance between tracts, counties and states (USALEEP 2010-2015, 65,662 tracts)
rule: Round 68 criterion (110c22e): replicated when each share is within 5 points of the published value and the order is tract > state > county.

frame.outcome: USALEEP e(0), every tract with a value (Maine and Wisconsin are not covered)

engine_route.note: three-level REML null model (Round 73); share intervals are exploratory and skipped here

tolerance.text: each share within 0.1 point of Round 68
